name: ascent_tower_from_excited_seed

phase_0.boundary_condition: the hermetic glass vessel containing the pressure of the ascent

VINIT.justification: the state of the vessel before the introduction of the excited seed

TANCH.justification: the final structural limit that terminates the vertical growth

AFWD.justification: the directed movement of matter from the base toward the apex

AREV.justification: the cooling and descent of vapors back to the source

CLINK.justification: the sequential addition of tower levels through repeated crystallization

IMSCRIB.justification: the internal core that maintains the identity of the tower during expansion

FSPLIT.justification: the division of the rising sap into volatile vapor and fixed mineral

FFUSE.justification: the recombination of vapor and mineral into a solid structural unit

EVALT.justification: the successful fixation of a new tower segment

EVALF.justification: the failure to fixate resulting in a return to the fluid state

ENGAGR.justification: the state where the seed is neither fully liquid nor fully solid

IFIX.justification: the permanent hardening of a layer that cannot be re-dissolved

phase_3.void_description: the empty interior of the vessel before ignition
phase_3.true_description: a stable and rigid tower segment
phase_3.false_description: a collapsed or molten residue at the base
phase_3.both_description: the turbulent transition zone where matter is both rising and falling

steps.domain_action: the vessel is purged of all previous residues
the seed recognizes its own potential for verticality
the initial point of contact is etched into the glass base
the seed absorbs heat and begins its first upward extension
the rising essence divides into a structural frame and a filling vapor
the frame finds purchase on the vessel walls
the vapor binds to the frame to create a solid floor
the essence reconstitutes as a stable platform for the next stage
the first level of the tower is permanently fixed
the process repeats as the tower seeks a higher elevation
the essence divides again to navigate a narrowing aperture
a portion of the essence fails to climb and falls back to the previous level
the descent is recorded as a temporary loss of momentum
the falling and rising essences meet in a state of suspended tension
the tension resolves as the falling essence is re-absorbed into the rising column
the unified column pushes through the aperture
the second level achieves structural integrity
the second level is permanently fixed
the tower confirms its alignment with the vertical axis
the tower reaches the top of the vessel and seals the ascent

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the external heat source applying thermal pressure
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: capillary action within the central pith
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the crystalline lattice of the fixed levels
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the rate of evaporation and condensation
phase_5.alfs_store: the geometric blueprint inherent in the seed

phase_6.cycle_cost: thermal energy from the external furnace
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: a single concentrated seed at the base
phase_6.post_cycle_state: a rigid vertical structure spanning the vessel height
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the increase in structural order is balanced by the dissipation of heat into the surrounding air
